answer_1.quote: In this paper, we introduce GraphQLRestBench, a new benchmark for evaluating sequential function calling performance of Large Language Models (LLMs). GraphQLRestBench leverages GraphQL schema for input-output variable mapping and code generation.
answer_1.outputs: Python code consisting of a sequence of function calls with accurate parameter mapping between functions
